dataset_attribution: Torres-Sospedra, J., Montoliu, R., Martínez-Usó, A., Arnau, T., and Avariento, J. (2014). UJIIndoorLoc. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

input.missing: the file's 100 ('not detected') is loaded as NaN
input.preprocessing: FillMissing(-104): NaN -> -104 dBm; no fitted statistics

target.note: errors are reported in EPSG:3857 metres, as in the literature; multiply by ground_scale for ground metres

neighbour_search: exact Euclidean; ties broken by training index, independent of BLAS/OpenMP threads
selection: k=5 fixed in advance; no hyperparameter search on the evaluation file

metrics.classification: floor and building accuracy in percent, reported separately
